answer: Seat every identity alone on a shared terrace for one live, timed micro-negotiation — haggle a price, settle a disputed delivery — while its replies dry in umber ink, each session raising a distinct plume of phrasing no other session shares. One operator can script a persona, but overlapping sessions demand separate sustained attention for every clone; missed beats, reused phrasing, and timing collisions expose the shared hand, so N convincing negotiators cost N times the attention, not N signups.
